items.source: /// Return true when the request carries an MPP payment credential.

items.name: has_payment_credential
items.source:
#[must_use]
pub fn has_payment_credential(headers: &axum::http::HeaderMap) -> bool {
    headers
        .get("authorization")
        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
        .is_some_and(|v| v.trim_start().starts_with("Payment "))
}
